title: Everyday Phrases — Booking a Hotel
title_quote: Do you have rooms available tonight?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏨 實用訂酒店必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Booking a Hotel
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用訂酒店情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Booking a Hotel phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have rooms available tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we have a room for two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi hæv ə rum fər tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I would like to book a room.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tɪ bʊk ə rum./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a room for two nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ə rum fər tu naɪts./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, I can book that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the price per night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is one hundred twenty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will give you a room at the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl gɪv ju ə rum æt ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 我幫您安排後面的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have a city view?
